label: Typed attachment profiles and token availability
term: Typed attachment profiles and token availability
definition: Era has before, gap and returned indices. FormToken has one designated constructor; BodyToken has two distinct primitive labels. Both profiles attach the original label before and no body at the gap; restored attaches original afterward, changedMate attaches other afterward. formAvailable is True throughout in both. This is a structural surrogate: no person, substantial esse, whole-organism unity, original matter or causal/psychological continuity is encoded. It is expressly not a countermodel to complete Thomistic hylomorphism.
note: Analyst structural test for issue1397. Historical source reconstruction and open person/body/form bridges are preserved in docs/notes/personal-identity-fission-1397.md. No source attribution claim is registered.
